items.name: Google Gemini
items.purpose: AI layer — newsletters, subtopic creation, country filtering, headline ranking (the primary AI provider)
items.quotaText: Free tier ≈ 10 RPM / 1500 requests/day per flash model (no usage API — see recorded call stats). · Recorded: 1234/1300 calls succeeded (95%) · last rate-limit 3h ago · last success 2m ago

items.name: Groq
items.purpose: AI fallback #1 — fast open models when Gemini is throttled
items.quotaText: ≈ 30 RPM / 14,400 requests/day — resets daily. · Recorded: 88/102 calls succeeded (86%)

items.name: OpenRouter
items.purpose: AI fallback #2 — aggregated models (last rung of the AI chain)
items.quotaText: Usage API says: $1.24 of $5.00 used (25% of limit) · free tier · Recorded: 40/45 calls succeeded (89%)

items.name: Resend (email)
items.purpose: Premium digest delivery — the only outbound email path
items.statusText: Key alive (send-only restricted key — cannot read domains, but sending works).
items.quotaText: Free plan: 100 emails/day, 3,000/month. Sender: digest@neutralwire.org (domain verified).

items.name: Google News RSS
items.purpose: PRIMARY source for custom subtopics + subtopic-creation validation
items.quotaText: Unauthenticated feed-reader endpoint — no published quota, occasional transient 5xx (one polite retry built in).

items.name: GDELT DOC API
items.purpose: My Country aggregation (all countries) + custom-subtopic supplement + creation validation
items.statusText: Timed out answering (the classic GDELT shared-IP throttle — its 429s take 10-12s just to arrive). Feed paths retry patiently and fall back to RSS.
items.quotaText: No published quota; throttle is per egress IP and clears on its own.

items.name: Bing News RSS
items.purpose: Image donor for custom-subtopic cards (thumbnails only, not content)

items.name: RSS pool (90+ outlets)
items.purpose: The main category feeds — every outlet in news-sources.ts (BBC, Sky, Guardian, Telegraph, Mail, Mirror, Standard, Express, NYT, CNN, Fox…)
items.statusText: Sample 3/4 healthy — NYT not answering right now.

items.name: Firebase RTDB
items.purpose: The entire data layer — caches, accounts, subscriptions, feeds, health stats
items.quotaText: Spark free plan: 1GB stored / 10GB/month download (the ETag cache keeps real usage far below).
items.file: src/lib/firebase-server.ts (DB_URL constant — no key: public read/write rules)

items.name: ip-api.com (geo)
items.purpose: Server-side visitor country detection (My Country / Relevant tabs)
items.quotaText: Free for non-commercial: 45 requests/minute per IP (cache-first usage in the app).

items.name: Ko-fi (payments)
items.purpose: ACTIVE payment flow — Premium/Ultra purchases + donations land as webhooks
items.statusText: Inbound webhook: configure it in the Ko-fi dashboard (Developer → Webhooks) → https://neutralwire.org/api/kofi/webhook. No outbound API to health-check.
items.quotaText: Ko-fi takes its own fee per payment; no API quota.
items.file: src/app/api/kofi/webhook/route.ts (inbound — NeutralWire never calls out to Ko-fi)

items.name: Stripe (legacy checkout)
items.purpose: Legacy subscription checkout verify path — Ko-fi is the ACTIVE payment flow
items.statusText: No STRIPE_SECRET_KEY env var — Ko-fi webhook (free/donation flow) is the active payment path.

items.name: Google Sign-In
items.statusText: Credentials present; Google auth endpoints up. NOTE: consent screen was still in Testing mode last checked — publishing it unlocks non-test emails.

items.name: Apple Sign-In
items.statusText: Env vars missing — the Apple button is hidden until they are set.

items.name: Web Push (VAPID)
items.purpose: Browser push notifications — broadcasts + breaking stories
items.statusText: Using the baked-in VAPID key pair — fine, but rotating to env keys invalidates old subscriptions.
items.quotaText: Push service (FCM/APNs/web-push) is free; no quota. Endpoint health is per-subscription — see the Push tools card.

items.name: Vercel cron
items.purpose: Server-side refresh-all (RSS + email tail) + digest catch-up sweep
items.statusText: Scheduled by the Vercel platform (header-authenticated). Off-visitor guarantee for feeds and digests.
items.quotaText: Hobby plan: cron invocations share the serverless execution budget.

items.name: cron-job.org (external)
items.purpose: Every-30-min tick that fans out to refresh + digest (independent of Vercel)
items.statusText: Deliberately NOT pinged by this board (a GET would fire real work). If digests stall, check the cron-job.org dashboard for failures.
items.quotaText: Free tier: unlimited-ish jobs at ≥1-min intervals.
items.file: Configured in the cron-job.org dashboard → hits /api/cron/* with the secret (URLs in src/app/api/cron/*/route.ts headers)
